coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public cadastral parcel geometry around the unchanged Jundiaí WUP settlement locator. Thirteen aligned cells and 205 unique full parcels passed stable counts, complete paging, fresh native-ID geometry reads, correctly shaped explicit absence and full-parcel one-parcel binding. Root independent EPSG:31983 GEOS audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The exact unchanged WUP locator has no parcel hit in its containing cell; nearby public parcel BR-JUNDIAI-LOTES-JUND-GID-46298 supports complete one-parcel binding. Native gid identifies individual GIS ground polygons; the duplicate codlote business reference is not used as runtime identity. Evidence is bounded and does not establish citywide or nationwide completeness, survey precision, legal ownership or currentness.

remainingUncertainty: Bounded qualification does not establish citywide completeness, source continuity, legal title meaning or survey accuracy. Native gid represents GIS polygon identity; codlote is not unique.
